categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Jasic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the welding and cutting equipment manufacturing industry. Its main business includes the research, development, production, and sales of inverter welding machines, welding and cutting accessories, welding materials, and welding robots. The company offers a wide range of products including MIG/CO2 welding machines, pulse MIG welders, manual arc welders, pulse TIG welders, plasma cutting machines, submerged arc welders, and handheld laser welding machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced digital control platforms based on DSP+ARM technology for its welding machines, enabling full digital control and enhanced welding performance. It integrates traditional welding processes with automation and digital technologies to increase product value. Production methods include lean manufacturing and intelligent manufacturing with automated production lines to improve labor productivity and product quality. The company also emphasizes quality management systems certified by ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, and QC080000 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jasic serves industrial customers across multiple sectors including shipbuilding, petrochemical, engineering machinery, vehicle manufacturing, pressure vessels, railway construction, and hardware processing. Its products are used in both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Americas, and emerging markets such as the Middle East and South America. The company’s customer base includes authorized dealers and end-users requiring welding solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with subsidiaries and sales networks in China, the United States, Europe (Italy), and other regions. It has a strong presence in domestic Chinese markets and exports over 50% of its sales revenue internationally. Key operating regions include Shenzhen (headquarters), Chongqing, Chengdu, Changzhou, Huizhou, and overseas markets through subsidiaries in the US and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jasic operates primarily in the midstream segment of the welding equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling welding machines and related accessories. It sources raw materials such as electronic components, steel, and non-ferrous metals from upstream suppliers and sells finished products downstream through authorized distributors and direct sales to industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on digitalization, automation, and intelligent manufacturing of welding equipment. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new digital welding machines, including the JET20 Pro series and EVO20 series, and expands into industrial welding machines and handheld laser welding. Jasic emphasizes innovation in welding technology, product diversification, and expanding high-end product lines to maintain competitive advantage and support internationalization.
categories.revenue_model: Jasic generates revenue mainly through the sale of welding machines, welding accessories, welding materials, and welding robots. The sales are conducted primarily via an authorized dealer network complemented by direct sales channels. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of delivery and customer acceptance, with export sales recognized upon customs clearance. The company also earns income from financial investments and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jasic is a leading domestic player in China’s welding equipment manufacturing industry, competing with international brands such as Lincoln Electric, Miller, ESAB, and Fronius. It holds a strong position in the mid-to-high-end welding machine market in China and is expanding its presence in industrial welding and robotic welding sectors. The company differentiates itself through digital technology integration and comprehensive product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jasic reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.26 billion, representing a 9.9% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders grew by 25.46% to RMB 255 million. The company’s total assets reached about RMB 3.04 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 2.24 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased sales volume and improved gross margins.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jasic emphasizes providing stable, reliable, and fully digital welding products that integrate traditional welding craftsmanship with advanced automation and digital control technologies. Its value proposition includes high product quality, comprehensive after-sales service with nationwide warranty, and a broad product portfolio covering various welding needs. The company’s continuous innovation and strong R&D capabilities enable it to offer customized solutions and maintain a competitive edge in both domestic and international markets.
